name: Mycelium
description: Contaminateur infectant les équipements ennemis avec des spores corrosives affaiblissant leur efficacité opérationnelle.

subject.archetype: Mycelium — Fléau Spore Common class furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Living fungal armor growing and pulsating in rhythm with host's heartbeat, toxic spore clouds emanating perpetually from pores across entire surface creating visible green haze, thick mycelial reinforcement visible beneath surface like living root systems, organic matter and fungal growths dripping from every edge with new growth visibly sprouting during combat
loadout.arsenal: Living spore projection organ on forearm launching concentrated toxic bursts at high velocity like organic projectile weapons, toxic secretion glands in fingertips pulsating and releasing corrosive droplets that sizzle on contact, thick mycelial whip extending from back acting as ranged organic weapon that lashes out to grapple targets The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's death ability targeting adjacent_on_flip, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Arms thrown outward while flipping between states, focused targeted shockwave of energy exploding from captured body affecting all adjacent positions simultaneously
attitude.emotion: Focused determination — seasoned professional locked in the moment of combat

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Toxic Green
palette_names.role: primary_accent — spore clouds and acid splash effects

palette_names.name: Decay Brown
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — rotting surfaces and decomposing matter

palette_names.name: Corrosive Yellow
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — acid burns and infection glow

color_and_light.lighting_setup: brushed steel utility frame, simple geometric corner markers, no ornamentation, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Eye-level medium shot capturing face and primary action clearly, shallow depth of field, motion freeze at peak of action

scenography.setting: Biologically devastated battlefield completely consumed by fungal infestation, thick toxic spore clouds reducing visibility creating oppressive green haze, massive mycelial networks pulsating and growing visibly across all surfaces converting terrain into living organism, both ally and enemy positions attacked by spreading infection, massive pulsating sacs bursting and releasing contamination, ground itself alive and hostile with fungal tendrils bursting through without warning
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Explosive circular shockwave radiating from character at flip moment, visible ring of energy passing through all adjacent positions with devastating force, Ground cracking in perfect circle around character, debris lifted and thrown outward, visible damage spreading through all adjacent positions, Massive spore explosion blasting toxic green clouds outward at high speed, thick mycelial tendrils bursting through walls and floors like organic spears, acidic fluid dripping from fungal growths creating sizzling smoke plumes, infection spreading visibly across surfaces like fast-forward timelapse consuming everything, pulsating organic sacs bursting on impact releasing concentrated contamination clouds
